items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And I do recall recording with Little Crying Jimmy Scott on his label.

ctx.x: Bud was using Max Roach and Curley Russell.

And he had several other acts, you know. Music combos and things. On his label. And I do recall recording with Little Crying Jimmy Scott on his label. You know, Little Jimmy Scott? You've heard of him?
